udt_struct_v0.doc: A time-bound, spend-capped agent credential to start the treasury with (the Leash).
udt_struct_v0.name: Leash

udt_struct_v0.doc: Everything a treasury needs to be useful on the first ledger it exists in.
udt_struct_v0.name: Setup

fields.doc: Amount of `token` deposited from the owner into the treasury (0 = unfunded). Refused\nas a whole if it exceeds the token's deposit cap.
fields.name: fund

fields.doc: Start a Leash for an agent key right away: empty = none, one entry = that agent.\n(A `Vec` rather than an `Option`: the SDK's spec cannot carry an optional struct.)
fields.name: leash

fields.doc: Most the agent may move per UTC calendar month (0 = no monthly limit).
fields.name: monthly_limit

fields.doc: Owner of the funds: becomes the treasury's admin AND root agent (as the app did).
fields.name: owner

fields.doc: Monthly caps on individual payees (may be empty). A cap does not approve its payee.
fields.name: payee_caps

fields.doc: Payees approved from the start (may be empty).
fields.name: payees

fields.doc: Record the treasury under the owner in the registry (cross-device recovery).
fields.name: register

fields.doc: Caller-chosen; the treasury address is derived from the factory and this salt.
fields.name: salt

fields.doc: SEP-41 / SAC token the treasury holds and spends.
fields.name: token

udt_struct_v0.doc: A monthly ceiling on what one payee may receive (v4).
udt_struct_v0.name: PayeeCap

udt_struct_v0.doc: A token the factory accepts and the deposit cap its treasuries are born with\n(0 = uncapped), in the token's own units.
udt_struct_v0.name: TokenCap

function_v0.doc:
Deploy a treasury and set it up \xe2\x80\x94 one owner signature for the whole thing.

Order matters for atomicity only in the sense that any refusal (an incoherent
policy in the constructor, an invalid Leash, an unfunded owner) aborts the entire
transaction: no half-configured treasury can exist.
function_v0.name: create

function_v0.doc: The tokens a treasury from this factory may hold.
function_v0.name: tokens

function_v0.doc: The deposit cap a treasury of `token` is born with (0 = uncapped), or `None` for a\ntoken this factory does not accept.
function_v0.name: deposit_cap

function_v0.doc:
Pins the treasury code, the registry and the accepted tokens with their deposit caps.
Immutable after deploy (no setters): a factory that could be re-pointed would be a way
to hand users different code, and one whose caps could be raised would make the beta
bound a promise only.
function_v0.name: __constructor
